root_cause: Canonical eight-slot Mira public-source radar selects only 12 entrepreneur portal problems while personal LinkedIn observational source selector accepts only 9 distinct fresh daily-life topics. Both jobs can be green but no eligible personal source is ever supplied; 2026-10-29 had zero fully qualified personal-life signals and five duplicate-safe blocked attempts.
prevention: Use the existing single radar scheduler and eight total provider calls: six original business and two date-rotated personal-life query slots, in same signal table with mutually exclusive source contract. Keep source publication <=45d, score>=0.72, independent HTTPS/public text, unique source, no first-person claims, original dedupe/identity gates and Meta/Mira source isolation. Portal must show source counts separately from provider post status, fail closed on missing count. Do not mark outcome live until original provider ID and independent readback.

evidence.source: production Supabase source inventory and GitHub original radar code
evidence.user_safety: public-safe, no source-content, private drafts, tokens or personal data
